svg.title: LoRA base and adapter branches
svg.desc: The same input x with shape N by 8 enters a frozen W of shape 12 by 8, and a trainable A of shape 2 by 8 followed by trainable B of shape 12 by 2. Scale the adapter output by alpha over two and add to the base output. The result has shape N by 12. Bias is omitted.
